picture.alt: A task's record with the header reading Background work, running since a time of day, above the task's title

entries.title: A task's background work says when it started
entries.body: While a crewmate's work runs in the background, the top of its task record now says "Background work · running since" and the time it began, on your computer and on your phone. It tells you when the work started, not when it will finish. Before, the line gave no time at all.
